reviewSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Subject unmoved at 15485a2f…, mode 0444. All 23 dispatched attacks were run and all 23 refuted, plus 6 independent attacks of my own, all refuted. The digest surface is clean: 13 of 13 cited pairs recomputed MATCH, including the two path-less occupancy digests, which resolve by content search to harness.DR-G18.lifecycle-generation-recovery.v4.json and .v2.json. The recital discipline the dispatch worries about holds everywhere: v4's currency is stated as draft-time current with the not-current claim scoped to 'after this successor is recorded' on every occurrence; occupancy v4 and lifecycle leftover-join.v3 are the current ones and their predecessors are marked demoted; DR-107 is recited as PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW three times and never flattened; DR-G18's own OPEN token is used without importing DR-107's. leftoverDesign is [OBL-G18-FX-AUTHORING] in both the draft and the subject, neither empty nor padded with OBL-ENCODING-RESERVED. The Stage A observation rows are the sharpest test and they pass exactly: the string 'observationsNotFindings' occurs zero times in the Claude file and 'advisor' occurs zero times case-insensitively, so 'no field, no advisories' is literally true, while Codex carries the field as an empty list with observationCount and advisoryCount both 0 — the draft states each differently and correctly, invents no identifier for either, and explicitly declines the 'both reviewers' identifiers preserved' claim. The no-cell-edit branch enumerates 26 items for an expected 26 and omits D-236, which is independently the last commit to touch file 08. Two things I checked beyond the dispatch are worth recording: the reversibility unwrite-list (D-086/D-193/D-216/D-262) is the exact D-262 shape resolved for G18 against live COORD headings, and the claim that leftover-join.v4 cited occupancy v2 as the specification was confirmed in v4's own bytes rather than inherited from the Stage A summary. My two observations — path-less occupancy citations and a remeasurement clause whose enumeration omits the three historical leftover-join versions — are not findings: the first resolves unambiguously and follows adopted precedent, and the second inverts on a correct reading of the clause's trigger, which fires on any cited file moving.
